:::{#exm-argmax-positive-multiple}
#### A quadratic and its positive multiple

With $g(x) = x(4 - x)$ of @exr-argmax-quadratic and $f = 5\,g$ of @exr-argmax-scaled-quadratic,
@thm-argmax-positive-multiple (with $c = 5$) gives $\argmax_{x \in [0, 4]} f(x) = \argmax_{x \in [0, 4]} g(x) = \cb{2}$,
the same [argmax](#def-argmax) as the exercises found.
The largest [values](functions.qmd#def-value) differ, $f(2) = 20$ and $g(2) = 4$,
so only the argmax is unchanged by the multiple.

<!-- no-figure: the example compares two numbers, and the two curves differ only by the factor 5 -->

:::
